hero.title: How the KnowChamp Excellence League
hero.subtitle: Your Journey from School Champion to State Champion Starts Here! Discover, compete, and shine bright.

steps.title: Register
steps.description: Register through your School Coordinator or directly on the KnowChamp platform with basic details and DOB.

steps.title: Automatic League Selection
steps.description: Based on your age, the system automatically assigns you to the appropriate Excellence League.

steps.title: View Details & Prepare
steps.description: Visit the Contest Details page to review theme, assessed skills, pattern, duration, official rules, and sample activities.

steps.title: School Competition
steps.description: On competition day, all registered students compete at their own school in quizzes, creative arts, speaking, and problem-solving.

steps.title: School Champions
steps.description: Schools announce 1st 🥇, 2nd 🥈, and 3rd 🥉 place winners per league who qualify for Sub-Division.

steps.title: Sub-Division Level
steps.description: School winners across the same Sub-Division compete head-to-head, giving students a broader platform to showcase talent.

steps.title: District Championship
steps.description: Top performers from Sub-Divisions advance to the District Level, competing with elite minds from across the entire district.

steps.title: State Grand Finale
steps.description: District champions clash at the State Grand Finale for prestigious titles, trophies, medals, certificates, and cash prizes!

callout.title: Rules & Fair Play Guidelines
callout.description: State-of-the-art anti-cheat detection, quick results calculation, and multi-signature security protocols ensure all contests are completely clean, secure, and 100% fair.
